messages:
Lydia C: Heads up  ORION ANALYTICS (acct: ORION-91) invoice INV-7890 for $18,450 is 30 days past due. Their account shows 'autopay failed' yesterday. I left a message for their AP (ap@orion.ai).
Maria H: Thanks Lydia. Did autopay fail due to card decline or bank error?
BillingBot: Autopay attempt failed for INV-7890. Reason: expired card on file. Retry scheduled in 48 hours. Payment link: https://pay.redwood.ai/inv/INV-7890
Lydia C: AP replied: "We need an itemized invoice + amended VAT line for EU entity." They say payment depends on receiving new docs.
Aj Patel: They switched billing entity during renewal, didn't tell us. I can reissue invoice to ORION SAS but need VAT ID and PO number.
Maria H: Ok reissue is fine but we should also propose a short-term arrangement so services aren't suspended. Proposal: reissue to ORION SAS, offer 30-day deferred pay (no penalty) and require signed acknowledgement of revised invoice. If they miss the deferred date, escalate to collections. Thoughts?
Sam R (Legal): We can offer a one-time 30-day deferral for EU re-billing. No fee. Document it via a signed amendment email thread or simple SOW addendum. If they miss the deferred date, we may enact the contract suspension clause. Also capture VAT ID and PO.
Lydia C: I'll request VAT ID and PO now and CC billing.
Aj Patel: Sending updated invoice draft to Lydia for approval. Also proposing a payment-arrangement email copy: 
```
- Invoice: INV-7890 for $18,450
- Reissue to: ORION SAS (VAT: __________)
- Deferred payment: full amount due 30 days from reissue date
- If unpaid after 7 days past due, service may be suspended; after 30 days, account to be referred to collections
```
Maria H: Fine but change suspension window to 14 days past deferred due date (gives them breathing room). Collections referral after 45 days. Also require ACH or wire; no further card attempts.
Lydia C: Noted. I'll include those terms and request signature.
BillingBot: Draft invoice INV-7890-RE issued to ORION SAS. Payment link updated.
Lydia C: AP sent VAT ID and PO-4432. They signed the acknowledgement in email thread (attached). They requested a split payment: 60% now, 40% in 30 days. Do we accept split?
Maria H: Split is ok if they pay 60% via wire within 5 business days and commit in writing to the 40% on day 30. No discounts. Add late fee clause for the 40% if not paid on time.
Aj Patel: I'll get exec sign-off. Quick note: customer asked if we can resume service immediately after the 60% posts.
Sam R (Legal): We can restore service on receipt of the 60% payment and confirmation of the payment plan. Document everything.
BillingBot: Payment of $11,070 received for INV-7890 (txn: WIRE-123321). Remaining balance: $7,380.
Lydia C: Received payment and restored API keys per CS runbook. I've updated the ticket and attached signed ack.
Maria H: Updating ledger. Setting invoice status -> "Partial Payment Plan". Remind me to follow up day-28 for the remainder.
CollectionsBot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up for INV-7890 balance on 1742482345. If unpaid by 1742532345 escalate to Collections partner.
Maria H: Thanks everyone. If they miss the 40% we'll re-open and discuss next steps (collections vs. write-off).
